title: Kit Store GitKraken-Style History Window
description: Introduce a GitKraken-inspired history window kind in the Kit Store storybook app that visualises the complete kit tree — root (initial kit), checkpoints (chronological vertical column, latest on top), alternatives (left lane, highlighted-on-hover), drafts (stacked bubbles on the current tip), and releases (marked checkpoints). Extend the wasm VCS state endpoint to expose parent/message/time/authors/hash/release for checkpoints, alternative lineages with ordered checkpoint ids, and session→draft trees so the new window can render edges without guesswork. Wire a new KitTreeGraph component into the story layout alongside the existing VCS panel without regressing existing behaviour.
summary:
Introduced a GitKraken-inspired `Kit tree` window in the KitStore Storybook app that visualises the full kit history:

- **Left column**: alternatives list (one color lane per alt + `the kit`). Hovering an alt highlights every checkpoint on its line across the main column; clicking selects it (wires `altId` through to `HistoryControls`).
- **Main column**: checkpoints sorted chronologically (uuidv7 → latest on top) with lane dots, `HEAD` / `release` / `the kit` badges, message, parent pointer, hash, change count, and authors count. Clicking selects `cpId`.
- **Draft bubbles**: pinned to the parent checkpoint row (or "Drafts on root" strip below) showing session + draft ids, finalized transaction count, redo-stack count, open-tx indicator, and alternative-target flag.
- **Root card** at the bottom of the column shows the initial kit id + name.

Under the hood:

- Extended `KitStoreHandle.vcsState()` in [compose/rs/lib.rs](compose/rs/lib.rs) from flat id arrays to a rich tree: per-checkpoint `parent`/`message`/`time`/`authors`/`hash`/`isRelease`/`changeCount`, per-alternative ordered `checkpoints`, per-session nested drafts with `parentCheckpoint`/`targetAlternative`/`finalizedTransactionCount`/`redoTransactionCount`/`openTransactionId`/`canUndo`/`canRedo`, plus `root: { id, name }` and ordered `theKitLine`.
- Rebuilt the wasm package via `wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg` so the new API is live.
- Added the `KitTreeGraph` component as a new region (with `📦VcsState shape`, `🎨Lane palette`, `🔎Selection`, `🧮Layout derivation`, `🖼️KitTreeGraph component`, `🧭KitTreeAlternatives panel`, `📜KitTreeCheckpoints column`, `💾KitTreeDraftBubble`, `🏷️KitTreeOrphanDrafts` subregions) inside `HistoryControls.tsx` — avoided creating a new file per CLAUDE.md; grouped next to the VCS button grid since both wire into the same store.
- Wired the component into `KitStore.stories.tsx` as a new `ks-tree` window between the VCS controls and the commands column. Selection flows back into the existing `cpId`/`altId`/`sessionId`/`draftId` state on `useKitStore`, so clicking a checkpoint auto-populates the "New alt (from cp)" / "Mark cp release" buttons.
- Fixed a pre-existing storybook build blocker: set `config.worker.format = "es"` in `.storybook/main.ts` so Vite's code-splitting works with the module worker that `compose/js` spawns. Without this, storybook build errored with "Invalid value 'iife' for option 'worker.format'".

Runtime verification: `storybook build` exits 0 in 55s, producing `storybook-static/`. `tsc --noEmit` shows zero new type errors introduced by this ticket (pre-existing errors in `nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts` and `ui/index.tsx` are out of scope). The wasm compile + bind via `wasm-pack` succeeds, producing the richer `vcsState` binding in `compose_bg.wasm`.
